metadata.description: Skills that make an AI agent report what it cannot do. root-cause forbids a causal claim without evidence and recurses to a structural cause. sitrep forces the finding into the first sentence, bad news above good news, stated confidence, and a named gap for anything unverified. honest-code applies the same discipline to the code itself: no hidden state, no swallowed error, no implicit default, and it delegates every mechanically decidable rule to a linter rather than claiming a verdict it did not reach. Ships clarity.py and pre-commit hooks, so the rules are checks rather than advice.

plugins.name: honest-skills
plugins.description: Evidence discipline for AI agents and for the code they write: no unproven causal claims, no buried bad news, no unstated confidence, no silent failure.
